blink_own.description: Exiles a creature or permanent (you control, or any target; field scope) or itself and returns it to the battlefield (flicker); a land target counts as blink of a land.

bounce_any_creature_target.description: Returns a target creature or permanent to its owner's hand without limiting it to opponents (own creature can be chosen, rule text only).

bounce_mass_includes_own.description: Returns all (nonland) permanents or all creatures to their owners' hands, own included.

bounce_own_creature.description: Returns a creature or permanent YOU control (chosen or each; a creature among the legal choices) to its owner's hand.

bounce_own_land.description: Returns a land you control to its owner's hand (bounce land; the land can be played again).

bounce_own_other_permanent.description: Returns an artifact or enchantment you control to its owner's hand (not a creature).

bounce_self.description: Returns ITSELF to its owner's hand.

cast_creature_draw.description: Cast trigger on a creature spell (or any spell) whose effect draws a card.

cast_trigger_any_spell.description: Trigger on casting any spell (unrestricted), which includes creature spells.

cast_trigger_creature.description: Trigger on casting a creature spell (Whenever you cast a creature spell ...).

cast_trigger_other_type.description: Trigger on casting a restricted kind of spell (instant/sorcery, artifact, a tribe, mana value restriction ...): does not fire on every creature spell.

cost_reduction_any_spell.description: All spells you cast cost less.

cost_reduction_creature.description: Creature spells you cast cost less.

cost_reduction_typed_spell.description: A type or subtype of spells other than creatures costs less (instant/sorcery, a tribe).

creature_dependent.description: Needs creatures to do anything (Aura, Equipment, anthem, 'for each creature you control').

edict_symmetric.description: Each player sacrifices creatures: the own too.

etb_doubler.description: Makes triggers of permanents entering trigger an additional time.

etb_other_creature.description: Trigger of ANOTHER permanent when a creature enters (Whenever another creature you control enters ...).

etb_other_permanent.description: Trigger when another permanent that is not literally 'creature' or 'land' enters (token, artifact, Gate, a creature subtype such as 'a spider'); may include creatures.

etb_own.description: Own enter-the-battlefield trigger of a permanent (When ~ enters ...; also '~ or another X enters'), apart from landfall; Auras, lands and non-creatures count (field creature in the summary).

etb_own_draw.description: Own ETB trigger whose effect draws cards.

land_extra_drop_or_from_hand.description: Additional land drop, or puts a land card from the hand onto the battlefield.

land_onto_battlefield_effect.description: Searches for a land and puts it onto the battlefield, or puts a land from a graveyard onto it (lands that enter without a land drop).

landfall.description: Landfall: ability word or trigger when a land enters (own, or any player's); includes landfall conditions on spells.

mana_creature_cheap.description: Creature with mana value at most 2 that adds mana (or untaps a land for mana).

mana_creature_other.description: Creature with mana value 3 or more that adds mana (or untaps a land for mana).

noncreature_draw_or_ramp.description: Non-creature, non-land card that draws or ramps: it does not trigger Chulane (neutral to weak anti-synergy, not a penalty by itself).

self_cost_reduction.description: The card makes itself cheaper (convoke, delve, affinity, improvise, this spell costs less).

self_life_loss.description: Costs the controller life or deals damage to the controller.

symmetric_benefit.description: Gives each player a benefit (draw, land, mana, life ...): opponents profit equally.

untapper.description: Untaps permanents (can untap Chulane or mana sources).

wipe_one_sided.description: Mass removal restricted to opponents' creatures (spares the own).

wipe_symmetric.description: Destroys, exiles or shrinks all creatures (or all permanents) with no opponent restriction: hits the own creatures.
